notes:
**Drawing starts the moment you press the button, and the properties panel keeps up.** Selecting an object or starting to draw one no longer waits for anything: the panel on the right now switches in a few hundredths of a second instead of rebuilding itself on every click, so it is there the moment you let go. Double-clicking a tool button (Text, Barcode, Image, Box, Line, Indicia) places one of a reasonable size straight on the page, below whatever is already there.

**Barcodes are the right size from the start.** A new barcode, or one whose type you change, is sized to its specification instead of stretching to the box you drew: an Intelligent Mail barcode comes out at 22 bars per inch and 0.145 in tall, POSTNET and PLANET at 0.125 in, UPC/EAN at 100% magnification, 2D codes square. Resize the box and the bars keep their pitch.
